title: 2026年WFLS乒乓球校队成员选拔公告
excerpt: 校队成员选拔将于10月15日（周四）中午及社团课时间在体育馆（食堂三楼）举行，与现高二校队成员三局两胜定胜负，欢迎会打乒乓球、还未进校队的高一高二同学报名
content:
## 2026年WFLS乒乓球校队成员选拔公告

现高二校队面向全体同学公开选拔新队员，具体安排如下：

- **选拔时间**：10月15日（下周四）中午及社团课时间
- **选拔地点**：体育馆（食堂三楼）
- **参选要求**：会打乒乓球、现高一高二还未进校队的同学
- **报名要求**：报名时请写清年级、班级及姓名
- **选拔形式**：与现高二校队成员进行三局两胜比赛
- **预计结果**：高二队员可以不新增，若新增则最多新增1人；高一队员必须新增，且新增5-6人

**备注**：后续可能会发布更详细的信息或需要更改的信息，请同学们时刻关注，避免错过重要信息。详情可咨询龚雨煊、任安喆，或在群消息、官网中搜索。
title_en: 2026 WFLS Table Tennis School Team Selection
excerpt_en: The school team selection takes place on Thursday 15 October, at noon and during the club period, in the gymnasium (3rd floor of the canteen). Players will face current Grade-11 team members in best-of-three matches. All Grade-10 and Grade-11 students who play table tennis and are not yet on the team are welcome.
content_en:
## 2026 WFLS Table Tennis School Team Selection

The current Grade-11 school team is openly recruiting new members. Arrangements are as follows:

- **Time**: Thursday 15 October, at noon and during the club period
- **Venue**: Gymnasium (3rd floor of the canteen)
- **Eligibility**: any Grade-10 or Grade-11 student who plays table tennis and is not yet on the school team
- **How to sign up**: state your grade, class and name clearly when registering
- **Format**: best-of-three matches against current Grade-11 team members
- **Expected outcome**: the Grade-11 cohort may stay unchanged, with at most 1 new member if any; new Grade-10 members are guaranteed, 5–6 will be added

**Note**: more details or changes may be announced later — keep an eye out so you don't miss anything important. For enquiries, ask Gong Yuxuan or Ren Anzhe, or search the group messages and the club website.
